title: Recover from a failed session connection
summary: Keep session retries recoverable and provide a return to sign-in when verification cannot connect.

changes.detail: Retry rereads secure storage after a failed restore and no longer switches a valid session into a stuck loading state.
Localized Back to sign in action clears local credentials without requiring a working backend; protected content still requires authentication.
Extracted shared restore operation for startup and retry. Restarted local API on port 3002 and Expo web on port 8081; no deployment.

validation.detail: Pending focused session tests, typecheck, lint and history checks. Native device and real owner sign-in not yet tested.
validation.name: Regression and app checks
